description: This file contains Python source code implementing parsing logic for 'einops'-style tensor pattern expressions, including classes for expression parsing, validation functions, and pattern splitting.

classes.name: AnonymousAxis
classes.description: Represents an anonymous axis with a positive size, used internally in pattern parsing.

classes.name: ParsedExpression
classes.description: Represents a parsed tensor pattern expression, including its identifiers, structure, and validation logic.

methods.name: parse_pattern
methods.description: Splits a pattern string into left and right ParsedExpression objects, validating ellipsis usage.

methods.name: validate_rearrange_expressions
methods.description: Validates rearrangement expressions for consistency, including axis presence and sizes.

methods.name: comma_separate
methods.description: Converts a collection of dimension names into a comma-separated string, handling nested collections.
